questions: If you know your current macronutrient intake breakdown please provide the amounts of fats/carbs/protein.
For how long have you been consistent with this caloric intake? (if you haven't been fully consistent, then clarify below)
Have you lost, gained, or maintained your weight with your current nutrition approach?
How many untracked or free/cheat meals are you having per week and how do you manage these meals?
Are there any limitations to your eating or training due to work and/or school?
Do you cook most of your meals in bulk?
Do you eat most meals away from home or prepare at home?
Are you hungry on your current diet (scale 1-10)?
Do you want a meal plan with specific foods to eat or do you want a macro plan with flexibility for you to choose the foods?
If you track macros, what app do you use and how long have you been tracking?
List any foods or meals you really enjoy (favorite foods) in your current diet or anytime.
Also, list any foods you do not like:
Do you have good digestion, with no bloating, acid reflux, indigestion, constipation, diarrhea? How many bowel movements per day?
What is your current pre and post workout nutrition?
Any food allergies/sensitivities I should know about?
What doctor prescribed medications are you currently taking, dosage, and when?
What dietary health or performance supplements are you taking, dosage, and when?
If currently using PEDS, what are you using (compound and dosage) and how long have you been on this for?
How long have you been using PEDs for?
What side effects have you experienced with use of PEDs?
What is your current blood pressure?
When was the last time you had comprehensive blood work done? If you have a current lab, upload it below. If it's longer than 12 weeks, let's get labs conducted.
Do you have a family history of Cardiovascular or Kidney Disease, Diabetes, or Cancer? Any other condition that should be known of currently?
How many years have you been weight training for?
How many days a week can you train?
What is your current training split?
How many hours can you spend training per day?
What time of day do you normally train?
Do you normally do cardio in the fasted or fed state?
How many days do you do cardio and for how long?
What kind of machine do you use for cardio? What are the settings you use (rate, speed, etc)?
Do you know your heart rate during cardio or have a way to monitor it?
List any exercises to avoid in the design of your program and reason why:
Do you prefer to exercise at home, gym or somewhere else? What equipment and/or gyms do you have available to you?
Please list any injuries you have or have had in the past?
What do you view as weakness in your current physique?
List any other info you think I should know:
Do you have good sleeping patterns, and are you sleeping through the night, how many hours do you sleep for?
Do you feel fatigued during the day?
Have you ever been diagnosed with an eating disorder?
On a scale of 1-10 how stressed are you (10 being high stress, 1 being no stress)?
What kind of work do you do?
How many hours do you work per week?
What do you find helpful in a coach's communication and what is not helpful for you?
Can I share your photos on social media?
